Done. Summary:

- Wrote `out/T3/solution.py`: loads all 114 tensors from the input shards, casts the 112 named projection matrices (`q/k/v/o_proj`, `gate/up/down_proj` per layer) to bfloat16 via a regex matched only against those exact names, keeps everything else (embeddings, lm_head) float32, runs the four required assertions before writing, then greedily bin-packs tensors into shards under the 256 MiB tensor-data cap (oversized tensors — embed_tokens and lm_head — each get their own shard) and writes a `model.safetensors.index.json`.
- Ran it once — succeeded on the first execution, producing 114 tensors across 10 shards in `out/T3/`.
- Verified the index: exactly 114 tensors mapped, embed_tokens/lm_head each alone in a shard, remaining shards hold 14 tensors each within the byte cap.
- Wrote `out/T3/REPORT.md` per the template.
